tray.hintAllTip: Do not start again at the second group. Keep counting on.

hintLeftSay.one: You have {counted}. One left — say {next} next.

tray.hintStraightThrough: Counted straight through both groups, {a} and {b} make {sum}.
tray.countedOn: You started at {base} and counted on {toTap}. That makes {sum}.
tray.refuseSmaller: Starting at {value} means counting {bigger} more. Start at {bigger} and there are only {value} to count.
tray.rightZero: Adding zero left it exactly as it was: {sum}.
tray.refuseNoFingers: No fingers are up yet. Put {a} on one hand and {b} on the other.
tray.rightFingers: {left} on one hand and {right} on the other — {sum} fingers.
tray.wrongFingers: You have {raised} fingers up. Put {a} on one hand and {b} on the other.
